name: Honor
description: Before creating this paint, we asked for the opinion of 2000 veteran warriors. Our question was, "What's the most important thing in life?" They all had the same answer. "HONOR!" they roared in one voice.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on 22nd February 2019, as part of the 2019 Iron Days celebrations. Simultaneously it was added to Containers permanently.
